searchText: what's the best way to track the progress on the devnet-0? geth console 😛 587805323 / 600000000 TTD reached I lost all my peers so TTD was not reached on the canonical chain Okay TTD reached on the canon chain as well <parithoshj> Yea, sorry we're kinda flying blind for this devnet. IPs for nodes can be found here: https://github.com/parithosh/consensus-deployment-ansible/blob/master/merge-devnet-0/inventory/inventory.ini You should have SSH access to the nodes that belong to your team. If not, reach out and i can configure it. Otherwise, configs to setup your own node can be found here: https://github.com/eth-clients/testnet-configs/tree/main/merge-testnets/merge-devnet-0 The chain is chaotic right now, so i guess setting up your own nodes would work better in a while. I send EIP-4399 transactions on both before and after merge btw <timbeiko> Nice! Is there a way to query the beacon node about attestation percentages, etc? <parithoshj> you can check the metrics (curl metrics port and get the metric value), beacon_participation_prev_epoch_target_attesting_gwei_total/beacon_participation_prev_epoch_active_gwei_total should work on lighthouse are you synced Marius? I started my node about 5 minutes ago and can't sync Yes am synced now Also had a lot of problems finding peers both on el and cl thanks, it may be a matter of time then There might be an issue in geth right now which drops unsynced peers just got sync'd to head of merge-devnet-0 with ethereumjs<>lodestar 🙂 looks like it was able to recover after some errors as well
